criteria.requirement: Add respect_xml_space=False parse handler option. When enabled, xml:space="preserve" disables stripping for that element, inherited descendants and comments; xml:space="default" restores the caller original strip_whitespace policy in that subtree. Restore parent policy when an element closes, including item_depth callback paths, so siblings do not leak state. Recognize raw xml:space and expanded XML namespace attributes with configured separator; unknown values inherit. Preserve exposed attribute values, legacy default behavior and concatenation semantics, without promising ordered mixed-content fidelity.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
